reading_note: The arc traces how the Divine Human's image (the Lord's form of love and wisdom) is manifested into the lower planes for the sake of redeeming the trapped good (the Son crucified in the All), and how the hells, seeing this image, are inflamed by perverted desire and counterfeit it in their own creation — producing the natural man (Adam and Eve) as a likeness without truth. The teaching then expounds three lower moldings (sea-fire, earth-enthumesis, tree-boasting) by which the proprium fashions itself before the divine image's intrusion subdues it. The single arc: the Divine Human reveals his form not for the powers but for the soul; the powers counterfeit; yet by that very counterfeit the seal of the heavenly image is impressed into the natural mind, awaiting redemption.
